addr: 2nd Floor, Reliance Centro Mall, Bellandur, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560103, India

rev.t: Jollies at Reliance Centro Mall, Bellandur is an absolute gem! It is such a beautiful and vibrant place for kids, but honestly, we as adults enjoyed it just as much as the little ones. From the massive trampoline and thrilling slides to all …
I went with my son to the play area. He caught HFMD (Hand foot and mouth disease) after playing in this. Really bad. The price they charge they should disinfectant the place.

We had amazing time with friends for my daughter's birthday celebration party. Kids enjoyed their time with their friends and parents had fun as well trying their hands at arcade games. Special  thanks to manager Mr. Sanil and staff there …
